summary.text: Willard Haley is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 58, who assumed office on January 6, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Haley is a former administrator at the Eldon Career Center and a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Willard Haley was born in Boonville, Missouri, and graduated from Pilot Grove High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in agriculture from the University of Missouri in 1983 and a master's degree in practical arts and vocational and technical education from the university in 1985.
His career experience includes working as an administrator for the Eldon Career Center and as a farmer.
Haley oversaw the Eldon Chamber of Commerce and has been a member of the Missouri Farm Bureau, the Eldon Area Farmers, 4-H and the Miller County Fair board, among other groups.
In the Missouri House, Haley was assigned to the Pensions Committee for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Workforce Development Committee and also served on the Agriculture Policy, Conservation and Natural Resources and Rural Community Development committees.
